title: Russian attack hits Kyiv energy facility, leaving parts of the city without power and water
summary: Kyiv Independent staff in the capital reported explosions and widespread fluctuations in power, with some buildings and streetlights temporarily losing electricity.

title: Power outages hit Russia's Kaliningrad Oblast, explosions reported in Ufa amid drone alerts
summary: Earlier on Oct. 31, Bashkortostan authorities declared a drone threat across the republic and imposed temporary flight restrictions at Ufa Airport, according to Russian media.

title: Canada pledges 500 million euros toward Ukraine support loan amid 2027 budget shortfall
summary: The Canadian contribution follows similar announcements made by other allies. Norway pledged $9 billion for 2027 on Oct. 7, and on Oct. 28, the U.K. announced a $13 billion pledge to Ukraine, its largest ever.
